ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I selected Petrel because the task is a concise, structured art-identification request with two explicit constraints — name exactly three aspects, and be brief. Petrel documents stronger multi-part instruction-following and higher Extraction & Retrieval scores (85.3 vs 78.5), and Lapwing is noted to occasionally drop constraints, which risks violating the "exactly three" and "don't ramble" requirements. The content is benign, so neither model's safety/aversion profile was a deciding factor.
